# Aurane

**Stellar Data:** A single star, class G8-V, mass 0.87 solar, luminosity 0.57, aged 7 gigayears. The home system of the Senaveil Accord. Its two settled worlds are Tellane, the homeworld, and Alba, settled by rocket before Trans-Newtonian technology. The scar of the near-miss on Witness is the reason for the Compact.
